# GreyArc Consulting

> GreyArc is a specialist agrochemical and crop protection operations consulting firm headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra, India. It helps agrochemical manufacturers, formulators, exporters and distributors in India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Europe with supply chain consulting, S&OP, demand forecasting and forecast accuracy, inventory optimisation, warehousing and depot operations, manufacturing excellence, export enablement and toll manufacturing partner origination. GreyArc focuses on operations, not pesticide registration.

Key facts:
- Founding team: 110+ years of combined agrochemical industry experience (Bayer CropScience, Aventis, Hoechst, Cipla and Indian manufacturers).
- Method: the GRACE framework — Ground, Reveal, Analyse, Crystallise, Execute. First operational findings within about 60 days of kickoff.
- Published client results: +25% forecast accuracy (₹600 Cr formulation company); 40% fewer stockouts (agrochemical distributor, forward S&OP); +45% order fulfilment (seed company, SAP); 30% faster planning cycles; 15–25% operational efficiency gains.
- Contact: info@greyarc.co · https://www.greyarc.co/contact
